digest.component_or_area: grounding analyzer test suite and external tool integration
propositions: macOS test suite attributes 250.81 worker-phase seconds to external analyzer/grounding tests with individual phases up to 15.62s; reusing immutable scan results could reduce repeated tool startup but evidence is insufficient to remove real boundaries without operator approval

31 analyzed nodes show measured 68.4% timing savings in three immutable-fixture reuse experiments (57.707 worker-seconds combined), but realized savings require either test-boundary consolidation, explicit cross-process artifact caching, or distribution changes due to pytest-xdist worker-local fixture scoping

call-local OpenGrep configuration validation deduplication removes duplicate `semgrep --validate` invocations per source file without crossing test boundaries; two-call experiment shows 11.890s median saving (5.945s per scan) with equal evidence outputs

every unique analyzer failure mode—tool presence/absence, timeout, invalid output, rule discovery, evidence normalization, consumer fail-open/fail-closed—must retain at least one real invocation per external boundary and environment state
malformed OpenGrep SARIF, ast-grep JSON, and metric JSON branches lack direct exact-defect tests, creating a residual gap before broad invocation removal is approved
metric detector omits `scc --by-file` flag and cannot emit file matches; `scc --format json` without flag returns empty Files array (discovered bug: accepted-androgenic-elk)
